property_summary: For any caller who is the current owner, changeOwner(newOwner) must set c.owner() to exactly newOwner for every address argument; the mutant instead sets owner to msg.sender, so owner() != newOwner whenever newOwner != the caller.
change_summary: Replace `_owner = newOwner;` with `_owner = msg.sender;` so changeOwner sets the owner to the caller instead of the given address.
